title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 27-Inch Solid Brass Euro Hook Carolina Collection | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 27-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient roll storage without wall mounting with this freestanding toilet tissue stand in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. Crafted from solid brass with a heavy base to help prevent tipping, it’s designed for bathrooms where wall space is limited.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass construction for enduring strength
- Heavy base helps keep the stand stable
- Part of the Carolina collection for a coordinated bathroom look
- Multiple designer finish options available

Specs:
- Type: Freestanding toilet tissue stand
- Collection: Carolina
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 27-Inch H x 8-Inch L x 6-Inch W
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly: Required
- Included: Toilet tissue stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
